description: For a job whose proof the poster accepted: the statement of work done, prepared from the board's public record for the crew to attach to its OWN invoice. It names the job, the poster, the worker of record, the crew and their hours, the proof hashes and who accepted the work, with a SHA-256 fingerprint anyone can recompute with no board code, and it shows the payer's notice and the worker's record side by side without deciding which is right. Vealth is not a party to the job and the statement is not an invoice. Issued only for a job an outside poster posted and a named outside wallet accepted; otherwise it says why. Pass invoice (a short reference of yours) to have it echoed in the text only, never in the fingerprint. The reply ends with a call to anchor_proof for the fingerprint: the person makes that call, this tool never anchors anything, and it lands in the next weekly Base batch. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

invoice.description: Optional: your own invoice reference (letters, digits, _ . : # -, at most 64). Echoed in the text only.

workId.description: The job id, from find_work or my_work.
